intro: The two islands are separated by a 3 km channel called The Narrows.

chapters.title: Land
text: Mount Liamuiga, a dormant volcano, is the highest point. Green vervet monkeys, brought by settlers, roam the hills. Nevis Peak is often capped by cloud.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The islands are warm, with hurricanes from June to November.

keyTerms.meaning: A volcano that has not erupted for a long time.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Saint Kitts and Nevis' landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
